verdict.rationale: Mercury clearly supports issuing cards (mercury-docs-1, mercury-docs-2, mercury-docs-27) with granular user permissions and spend controls (mercury-docs-10, mercury-docs-11), and community evidence confirms real-world use of individually-limited cards for team members (mercury-comm-1). However, most marketing and community evidence emphasizes virtual cards specifically for spend/contractors rather than explicitly confirming physical card issuance workflows tied to defined employee roles.
